correctness.rationale: Reconstructed complete affine-plane matroid from F3²: 9 points, 12 lines, 72 independent triangles, 54 four-point caps. With 36 edges, boundary ∂2 has rank28 and an independently re-evaluated lexicographic 28×28 minor has determinant -1; therefore its image is the full saturated 28-dimensional one-cycle lattice and H2=Z^(72-28)=Z44, H1=0. Constructed full exact 44-element integral kernel basis via this unimodular pivot. Forming 44×54 cap boundary coefficient matrix, the stated 43×43 minor independently has determinant -1. Orientation area cochain signs on 72 triangles give zero on all 54 cap boundaries and values 0×32,+6×6,-6×6 on kernel basis; Φ=(1/6)∑orientation⋅z is integral and surjective with cap span equal to primitive rank43 kerΦ. AGL2(F3) det sign follows from transformation of oriented determinants, and 432 affine maps act transitively on 54 caps. No rational-to-integral rank shortcut. Reconstructed the two unit determinants and sign-value spectrum separately in original Python from geometric definitions, matching stated certificate.

value.rationale: The exact integral obstruction to generating all top cycles by smallest four-cap spheres is a natural geometric question for the smallest nonbinary affine plane. A primitive corank-one sublattice and determinant-sign quotient provide reusable precise lattice and symmetry information not implied by the Betti rank alone; small finite size is justified by canonical symmetry and complete classification.
